verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents automations that run unattended in the background. Payroll can be set to run automatically after setup, with alerts. A Payroll AI proactively collects time and attendance data, spots inconsistencies and texts the admin. Users can also automate multi-step HR processes and onboarding, and tax filing and 1099 delivery happen automatically. However, auto payroll is limited to salaried direct-deposit employees and includes a review/approve step, and the HR automations are built around approval chains rather than fully autonomous runs. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation builder beyond the predefined payroll/HR flows, auto payroll for hourly or non-direct-deposit employees, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these automations actually run autonomously.
